description: A card/tile-shaped radio item — the whole bordered surface is the interactive element, not a small control plus a separate label. Composes the headless RadioCard primitive (RadioCard.Root is role="radiogroup" with no visual anatomy of its own; RadioCard.Item is role="radio"). Sized xs–xl; `data-density` scales each size further.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
When `true`, Root delegates rendering to a single consumer-supplied
element via the {@link Slot } pattern instead of the default `<div>`;
`role="radiogroup"`, `aria-orientation`, `dir`, and remaining props
are merged onto it.

props.name: children
props.description:
The group's cards — typically {@link RadioCardItemProps`RadioCard.Item`}
elements, each optionally wrapping a {@link RadioCardIndicatorProps`RadioCard.Indicator`}.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Value of the card selected on first render. Omit for nothing selected
on mount.
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `value` instead.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Reading direction. In `"rtl"` the horizontal arrow pair is swapped so
Arrow Left moves forward. When omitted, it is inherited from the
nearest {@link DirectionProvider }, falling back to `"ltr"`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the new value whenever the selection changes. Optional in
uncontrolled mode.
Called with the new value whenever the user selects a card. Required
in controlled mode.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Which arrow keys move focus and selection through the group.
`"both"` enables all four arrows; `"horizontal"` only Arrow
Left/Right; `"vertical"` only Arrow Up/Down. When not `"both"`, the
value is also reflected as `aria-orientation` on the root.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
Forwarded to the underlying `HTMLDivElement`.

props.name: value
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — use `defaultValue` instead.
The currently selected value. Must be kept in sync by the parent via
`onValueChange`.

props.name: title
props.type: string & ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | string & Iterable<ReactNode> | string & ReactPortal | string & Promise<AwaitedReactNode> | undefined
props.description: The card's heading. Always present — the required content.

props.name: value
props.description:
Uniquely identifies this card within the group and is reported to
`onValueChange` / matched against Root's `value` when selected. Required.

props.name: description
props.description: The card's supporting text, shown below the title.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
Forwarded to the underlying `HTMLButtonElement`.

props.name: showDescription
props.description:
Shows or hides `description` without unmounting the title — a
separate, skippable subcomponent, not a change to the anatomy.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Card size; `data-density` scales each size further.

props.name: asChild
children
props.description: The visual mark shown while the parent Item is selected.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
When `true`, keeps the indicator mounted while unchecked so a CSS exit
animation can play against `data-state="unchecked"`. Consumers who set
it own the exit lifecycle.

api.description:
`<primitiv-radio-card>` — the state owner of a group of radio cards: tiles whose whole surface picks one value, exactly one of which is selected.

The root is a radio group: it takes `role="radiogroup"`, so name it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, and each card's `<button>` takes `role="radio"`. Only the selected card is in the page's Tab order — the first enabled one while none is selected — and the arrow keys move focus and selection together, wrapping at the ends and skipping disabled cards. By default all four arrows work, since cards usually wrap into a grid. A selected card never lets go: clicking it again changes nothing.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The selected card's value. Reflected: it changes as the user selects, so a server re-render or a history snapshot sees the live selection. Omit it for nothing selected.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Which arrow keys move between cards. `both` (the default) uses all four, for cards that wrap into a grid, and writes no `aria-orientation`; `horizontal` or `vertical` keeps to one pair and states it.

events.name: primitiv-radio-card-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven selection is applied, with the card selected afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

api.description: `<primitiv-radio-card-item>` — an interactive part: one card. It decorates exactly one child the consumer writes, a `<button>` holding the card's content, which gets `role="radio"`, `aria-checked`, `data-state="checked" | "unchecked"` and the roving `tabindex`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The card's value, the root's `value` while it is selected.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Skipped by the arrow keys and never selected (`aria-disabled` and `data-disabled` on the child).

api.description: `<primitiv-radio-card-indicator>` — the card's selected mark, placed anywhere inside its `<button>`. Decorative (`aria-hidden`), with the card's `data-state`, and `hidden` while its card is unchecked unless it carries `force-mount`.

attributes.name: force-mount
attributes.description: Keep the indicator shown while its card is unchecked, so a stylesheet can animate it in and out from `data-state`.
